personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (infused with 4 Tactile / Playful for Grab-style roundedness)
personality_one_liner: A highly tactile, approachable, and functional everyday food companion relying on soft geometry, crisp whitespace, and a high-energy brand green.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to screen edge. Sticky primary actions get proper scroll padding at bottom.

do's: Use glass for sticky bottom tab bar.
Use glass for sticky bottom CTA containers (e.g., View Cart, Confirm Booking).
Use glass for sticky headers over scrolling menus.
dont's: Never use on normal list rows or form inputs.
Never use without a tinted background layer to ensure readability.

screens.name: Onboarding & Auth
screens.purpose: Quick entry via OTP and location permission.

states.error: Standard inline error for invalid OTP.

screens.layout: Splash transitions into a clean bottom sheet for phone entry over a branded background. Followed by a full-screen location permission view with a map graphic and a sticky 'Use Current Location' pill CTA.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary navigation hub bridging all 4 core services.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for cards and tiles.
states.error: Banner at top: 'Unable to load feed', Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky Header: Location selector (glass) + Profile avatar. Row 1: 2x2 grid of large 'Service Tiles' (Delivery, Dine-in, Pickup, Book a Table) using brandSecondary backgrounds and distinct icons. Row 2: Horizontal scroll of Promo Banners (using gradient/image scrims). Row 3: Horizontal scrollable filter chips (Halal, Nasi Lemak, Western, etc.). Row 4: Vertical list of 'Restaurants Near You' cards (Edge-to-edge images with bottom radius, metadata below).

screens.name: Delivery (List & Detail)
screens.purpose: Browse and select restaurants for delivery.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty plate: 'No restaurants found for this filter.' + Clear Filters CTA.

screens.layout: List: Sticky filter header over a vertical ScrollView of Restaurant Cards. Detail: Parallax hero image with gradient-to-dark scrim, back button, and overlaid restaurant name/rating. Scrolling menu sections with 'Add' pill buttons. Sticky glass 'View Cart' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Menu Item Customization
screens.purpose: Configure a single item before adding to cart.
screens.layout: Full-screen modal or sheet. Hero image of food. Checkbox/Radio lists for add-ons (e.g., 'Extra Sambal', 'Fried Egg'). Sticky 'Add to Cart - RM 15.00' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Cart & Checkout

states.empty: Illustration of empty cart + 'Find something delicious' CTA.

screens.layout: List of cart items with increment/decrement steppers. Subtotal breakdown. Delivery address summary. Sticky glass checkout CTA.

screens.name: Order Tracking
screens.layout: Top half: Map view. Bottom half: Bottom sheet containing a vertical status stepper (Preparing -> Picked Up -> Arriving), driver details, and contact buttons.

screens.name: Dine-in Flow
screens.purpose: Table QR scanning, ordering, and split bill.
screens.layout: QR Scanner screen -> transitions to a Restaurant Menu tailored for Dine-in (shows Table # in header). Sticky 'View Tab / Pay' CTA. Payment screen includes a 'Split Bill' toggle and 'Call Waiter' floating action button (FAB).

screens.name: Pickup Flow
screens.layout: Similar to Delivery but includes a sticky horizontal time-slot selector (e.g., '12:00 PM', '12:15 PM') before checkout. Post-order screen highlights a large Order Number and 'Ready By' time.

screens.name: Table Booking
screens.purpose: Reserve a table for the future.
screens.layout: Form layout. Horizontal date ribbon. Grid of available times. Party size counter (+/-). Special requests text area. Sticky 'Confirm Booking' CTA.

screens.name: Account & History
screens.purpose: User settings and record of activity.
screens.layout: Top-level tabs for Orders & Bookings history. Vertical list of settings rows (Saved Addresses, Payments, Favorites) using tinted icon containers (brandTertiary rounded square + brand icon).

satay_skewers.alt: Chicken satay skewers with peanut sauce

instructions_to_main_agent: Design entirely in high-fidelity static screens using mock data. No backend or navigation interactivity is required per the brief.
Enforce strict adherence to the brand color #00B14F. Do not use blue or purple anywhere in the UI.
Use Malaysian mock data: Nasi Lemak Village, Ah Kau Char Kway Teow, Roti Canai Maju, Satay Station, Dim Sum Palace.
Implement the 4 Home screen tiles exactly as 'Delivery', 'Dine-in', 'Pickup', and 'Book a Table' positioned prominently below the location header.
Use pill-shaped buttons (radius 'pill') for primary actions to mimic the tactile Grab style.
Implement glassmorphism on the bottom tab bar and sticky 'View Cart'/'Confirm' CTAs at the bottom of scrolling screens to ensure they remain anchored and highly visible.
For restaurant/food imagery, always use the provided Unsplash URLs and ensure any text rendered over imagery uses a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) for readability.
List items and setting rows should use 'tinted icon containers' (a brandTertiary rounded square containing the icon) for visual polish.
